title: Jets Injury Notes: DB D’Angelo Ponds set to make NFL debut against Packers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets Injury Notes: DB D’Angelo Ponds set to make NFL debut against Packers
sources.description: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn ruled out four players for Sunday's Week 2 matchup with the Green Bay Packers, but announced rookie DB D'Angelo Ponds is set to make his NFL debut.
